Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid

Class WorldFluidPickup

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.fluid.WorldFluidPickup
public final class WorldFluidPickup extends Object
Loader-neutral world pickup of one bucket volume through vanilla's BucketPickup contract: a source block is removed, a waterlogged block keeps itself and loses only its fluid, and a block that refuses pickup keeps its fluid. Modern modded source blocks implement BucketPickup directly, so no loader fluid-capability wrapper is involved.

sourceAt(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos) is a read-only query of what one unit would yield. A caller decides whether that content is acceptable, checks protection, and only then calls take(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.StoredFluid, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent). take owns the world transaction, the fill sound, and the GameEvent.FLUID_PICKUP event; the caller supplies the loader-resolved fillSound and records the acquired content itself.

  • Method Details

    • sourceAt

      public static StoredFluid sourceAt(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos)
      Reports what one bucket volume of world pickup at pos would yield, without changing anything. No variant payload is carried: a vanilla BucketPickup block never exposes one.
      Parameters:
      level - level to query
      pos - block position to inspect
      Returns:
      one bucket volume of the source fluid at pos, or StoredFluid.EMPTY when the block is not a BucketPickup source

    • take

      public static boolean take(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, StoredFluid expected, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent fillSound)
      Removes one bucket volume of expected from the block at pos through its own BucketPickup.pickupBlock(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState) contract, then plays fillSound and emits the fluid-pickup game event. The world changes on the server only; the client predicts acceptance.
      Parameters:
      level - acting level
      pos - block position to draw from
      expected - fluid the caller requires; a different world fluid is rejected
      player - acting player, or null for automation
      fillSound - loader-resolved fill sound to play on success
      Returns:
      true when the block gave up a unit, or the client predicted it; false leaves the world unchanged

    • takeBlock

      public static boolean takeBlock(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos pos, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent fillSound)
      Removes the BucketPickup block at pos through its own BucketPickup.pickupBlock(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.world.level.LevelAccessor, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, net.minecraft.world.level.block.state.BlockState) contract, then plays fillSound and emits the fluid-pickup game event. This is the non-fluid counterpart of take(net.minecraft.world.level.Level, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.util.StoredFluid, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.sounds.SoundEvent): powder snow is a BucketPickup block with no fluid state. The block is removed on the server only; the client predicts acceptance and still plays the predicted sound and game event.
      Parameters:
      level - acting level
      pos - block position to remove
      player - acting player, or null for automation
      fillSound - fill sound to play on success
      Returns:
      true when the block gave up its pickup stack, or the client predicted it; false leaves the world unchanged

    • completePlayerPickup

      public static void completePlayerPickup(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack filledStack)
      Records vanilla bucket-pickup observability after the caller has stored the acquired content: the item-use statistic and the filled-bucket criterion.
      Parameters:
      level - acting level; client prediction is a no-op
      player - acting player; a null player (automation) is a no-op
      filledStack - the now-filled bucket stack, used to key the statistic and criterion
